description:
Dear Brothers,

🌳 we invite you to an afternoon of deep connection, authentic expression and embodied brotherhood.

🌬️ BREATHE & RELEASE
Dive into a guided breathwork journey to release tension, explore your emotions and create space for greater clarity, aliveness and inner freedom.

🔥 SURRENDER & REVITALIZE
Experience the transformative power of a sauna ceremony and cold plunge. Move through heat and cold with awareness. Strengthen your presence and reconnect with your inner resilience.

🌀 INTEGRATE & SHARE 
Give yourself space to feel, reflect and  experience the healing potential of being truly heard.

🌊 MOVE & EXPRESS
Let your body speak through intuitive dance and free movement. Express what words cannot, release held emotions, and reconnect with your natural joy, freedom, and vitality.

🙏 This is a space where we are welcome with everything what is alive. We don’t need to have it all figured out.
In our circle we can be seen, heard, supported and held by our brothers.

🥗 We will close the circle at 7pm. Afterwards you can stay for sauna & a nourishing warm dinner until 9pm for 10€. Please buy your online ticket for the food until Tuesday the 1.12. so we can plan the amount. 

🛖 AN INVITATION TO BROTHERHOOD
You don’t need any previous experience with breathwork, men’s circles or embodiment practices. 
Just bring your curiosity, your openness and two towels for the sauna & a water bottle. 

Let’s breathe together. Feel together. Move together. Grow together.

With Love 

Steffen & Fox 🙏
